items.title: Heat Wave Keeps Southeast Natural Gas Spot Market Cooking
items.summary: Southeast prices in the physical natural gas market rallied on Thursday as they have most of the week amid scorching weather conditions and forecasts for more ahead, offsetting setbacks elsewhere.

items.title: Golden Pass LNG Nominations Overshoot, Clouding Natural Gas Demand Signals
items.summary: Golden Pass LNG has been walking back an average 36% of its first-cycle nominations since July 30 as commissioning work leaves the Southeast Texas terminal’s early demand signals running well ahead of the feedgas it takes.

items.title: Plump Inventory Print Sends Natural Gas Futures Sliding
items.summary: Natural gas futures floundered following a federal inventory report that proved bearish relative to historical norms and market expectations.

items.title: Southeast Natural Gas Forward Prices Surge as August Heat Ridge Builds
items.summary: Natural gas forwards rebounded during the Aug. 6–12 trading period as gains topped 40 cents at Southeast hubs amid rising power demand and constrained pipeline capacity.

items.title: Latin America LNG Imports Hit 3-Year High as El Niño Takes Effect
items.summary: Latin America imports of LNG and vessel traffic through the Panama Canal leapt to three-year highs in July, according to Kpler data.

items.title: Midstreamers Say Now is Time to Rapidly Expand Western Natural Gas Infrastructure
items.summary: Optimizing natural gas pipeline flows and expanding infrastructure are among the top priorities for some of the leading midstream operators in the Western US market as more of the region’s capacity runs at full utilization.

items.title: Price Reaction Muted as EIA Confirms Plump Natural Gas Storage Build
items.summary: A weekly storage injection on the heavier end of expectations reinforced bearish sentiment around natural gas futures, which trended lower through midday Thursday.

items.title: Natural Gas Storage Build Catches Market Leaning Too Low
items.summary: The US Energy Information Administration (EIA) on Thursday reported a 36 Bcf net injection of natural gas into storage for the week ended Aug. 7, matching NGI’s forecast but coming in above many market estimates.

items.title: Warm Fall Forecast Tests Northeast Natural Gas ‘Winter Insurance’ After Volatile 2025/26
items.summary: A warmer-than-normal fall could delay the seasonal pickup in natural gas heating demand, but Northeast forward markets are carrying steep winter premiums following a 2025/26 season marked by dramatically higher price volatility.

items.title: DeLa Express Pivots Permian Natural Gas Pipeline to Texas, Targets 2030 Startup
items.summary: DeLa Express has withdrawn its proposed 2 Bcf/d Permian Basin natural gas pipeline from federal review and is recasting the project as a Texas-only intrastate system targeted for 2030 startup.

items.title: Russia’s Diesel Exports Crash to Multiyear-Low amid Tight Global Market
items.summary: Russia’s diesel and gasoil exports crashed in the first seven days of August to just 80,000 barrels per day (bpd), the lowest in many years, as Moscow extended restrictions on diesel exports amid a fuel crisis triggered by incessant Ukrainian attacks
